title: StoneReferenceProfile
description: The real, fixed construction-time parameters `geometry/stone/builder.py` and `geometry/stone/outline.py` use to build a StoneReference's crown/girdle/pavilion loft — documentation of an existing runtime construction contract, not a request/validation schema. Every value here carries `provenance: "software_reference_profile"` (brief section 22): a deliberate, deterministic geometry-engine/software construction choice, verified only to produce robust CAD geometry — never a sourced gemological or industry-standard proportion (STONE-GOV-011). See docs/bible/20-stone/567-stone-reference-geometry-contract.md.

crownFraction.description: Fraction of stone.depth allocated to the crown (table-to-girdle) region. Shared by every shape.

pavilionFraction.description: Fraction of stone.depth allocated to the pavilion (girdle-to-culet) region. Shared by every shape.

tableToGirdleRatio.description: Scale factor applied to the girdle outline to produce the table-level outline. Shared by every shape.

culetRadiusMm.description: round only: a fixed, absolute culet circle radius, unchanged since before Sprint 18.

culetScaleRatio.description: Every non-round shape: the girdle outline scaled down by this ratio to produce a small, self-similar culet-level outline — a real, documented geometry-engine numerical-stability accommodation (brief section 16), not a jewelry standard.

emeraldCornerClipRatio.description: emerald only: how far each corner is clipped diagonally, as a fraction of the smaller half-extent.

cushionCornerRatio.description: cushion only: rounded-corner radius, as a fraction of the smaller half-extent.
